reason: First hand port of the four nine-point ribbon build, projection and draw loops: three instructions short, and the draw-start clamp, loop-end test and odd-ribbon test are shaped differently.
Odd-ribbon local, clamped draw start and loop_end <= W(0x15E0) test fix the branch shape; the strided ribbon pointer is biased from the wrong field.
count++ before state = 0 in the restart path biases the ribbon pointer at +0x1F8 as retail does; the side length takes fp and the odd flag spills, the reverse of retail.
Permuter probe: an extra odd = i & 1 store in the second-mode end-point branch gives odd fp and spills the side length as retail does, but emits one extra reload and andi.

Second-mode interior points test odd with identical arms, like the first mode; the extra reference sets the allocation and post-reload cross-jumping removes the test. Exact in the French and Spanish model_variant_707 stage 9 slot 0 and stage 10 slot 1 images.
